content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice gives a total of 8 vacancies, all UR, for Assistant Professor (Grade I & II). It does not split the 8 posts by department or by grade. Applications are invited in the following areas.

rows.areas: Experimental electrochemistry and battery technologies; Process control and dynamics; Bio manufacturing; Semiconductors; Nanotechnology; Separation processes; Renewable energy; Critical Minerals; Polymer synthesis etc.

rows.department_school: Mehta Family School of Biosciences and Biomedical Engineering
rows.areas: Computational Biomolecular Modeling; AI/ML/DL for Biological/Biomedical/Healthcare Data; Computer Vision for Medical Image Analysis; Computational Health Informatics; Computational Multi-OMICS Data Science; Computational Epidemiology; Internet of Medical Things; Wearable Healthcare Devices; AI-driven Health Monitoring Systems; strong applications across all areas of Biosciences and Biomedical Engineering (as per the requirements) may also be considered

Applied Optics Lasers and Photonics; Hybrid Electric Vehicles; Quantum Technologies; Design and Communications, Innovation, System Design, Project Management; Robotics & Autonomous Systems; Computational AI-driven Engineering: Digital Twin and Multiscale Modelling

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The pay structure is as per the 7th CPC. HRA is not admissible if accommodation is provided within the campus. The posts carry allowances such as D.A., H.R.A and Transport Allowance as per GoI rules, corresponding at present to those admissible to Central Government employees stationed at Indore. LTC, Children Education Allowance and contribution towards the New Pension Scheme (NPS) are permissible as per GoI rules. The position of Assistant Professor Grade II will be on contract basis; the notice prints no contract length. Cumulative Professional Development Allowance (CPDA): Rs. 3 lakh for every block period of 3 years, which may be made available on a reimbursable basis for conference papers, professional body fees and academic/research contingency expenditure. Relocation Allowance: up to Rs. 1,00,000 for faculty joining from abroad (air fare for self and spouse and transport of goods), and up to Rs. 75,000 for self, family and goods for those joining from within India. Tickets must be booked through IRCTC or authorised agents (M/s Balmer Lawrie & Company Limited, M/s Ashok Travels & Tours). Medical Facility: cashless OPD and IPD in leading hospitals in Indore and the Institute Health Centre, for employees and dependent family members. Children Education Allowance: for the two eldest school-going children, classes nursery to twelfth, at Rs. 2,812.5 per month per child as per GoI norms. Communication charges are reimbursed under Institute/GoI rules. Accommodation: on-campus accommodation may be provided in lieu of HRA, subject to availability. For the initial 21 days after joining, a Guest House/HoR stay may be provided, with a token Rs. 2500 paid by the occupant or deducted from HRA. Research grants: Young Faculty International Dream Lab Research Experience Grant up to Rs. 5 lakh; grant up to Rs. 5 lakh for research and innovation with undergraduate students; Research Seed Grant of Rs. 2 lakh for the 5 best technologies. The notice also mentions R&D facilities in all departments, a library, and campus facilities including a bank, post office, shopping centre, Kendriya Vidyalaya school, health centre and sports facilities.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes shortlisting followed by interview. The Institute reserves the right to call for interview only those candidates shortlisted on qualification, experience, research, publication records and the requirements of the individual academic school. It may set different as well as higher norms while shortlisting. Meeting the minimum qualifications does not guarantee shortlisting or an interview call. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted by email at the address given in the application form. Applicants called for interview in person must carry original certificates and self-attested copies, failing which the candidature would be disqualified. Applicants from abroad will, generally, be interviewed through video conferencing. Those from abroad who are in India at the time of the Selection committee meeting must attend in person if called.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply online through the "Click here to apply ONLINE" link on the IIT Indore careers (teaching positions) page. Instructions for completing the application are available on the application website. Give full details of educational qualifications, including the year of obtaining Ph.D. and the date of defense certificate. Provide a list of publications with reprints of the best papers, teaching/research/industrial experience, date of birth, and the names and contact details of at least three referees. Upload all certificates in PDF with the online form. Submit a separate application for each position if applying for more than one. Ask the referees to send their reference letters by email to [email protected] . Complete the upload before 5:00 PM (IST) on 26 November 2026. Only online applications are considered; no hard copy or email submission is accepted. Queries: [email protected] or +91(0)731-6603556/3488 (Ext. 3556/3488), Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 05:00 PM. Applicants are advised to retain a copy of the submitted application, as the Institute will not provide one after submission.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: All educational qualification marksheets/certificates, including the Date of Ph.D. Defense, uploaded in PDF. Experience certificates stating designation, pay (pay slip for last 3 months) and tenure, duly signed and sealed by the employer. List of publications with reprints of the best papers. Names and contact details of at least three referees. Political and security clearance from the Ministries of External Affairs and Home Affairs, for individuals with foreign passports. At interview: original certificates and self-attested copies; and, for those employed in Government, Semi-Government, Autonomous Body, Institution or PSU, a No Objection Certificate with a Vigilance Clearance Certificate from the employer.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor vacancies are there at IIT Indore?
faq.answer: The notice states a total of 8 vacancies, all UR (UR – 8), for Assistant Professor (Grade I & II).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 26 November 2026, and the completed application materials must be uploaded before 5:00 PM (IST) on that day.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIT Indore Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Both grades need a Ph.D. with first class or equivalent at the preceding degree in the appropriate branch with a very good academic record throughout. Grade I also needs minimum three years of industrial/research/teaching experience, excluding Ph.D. experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIT Indore Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Maximum 32 years for Assistant Professor Grade II and maximum 35 years for Grade I, reckoned as on the last date of online submission of the application form.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IIT Indore Assistant Professor Grade I and Grade II?
faq.answer: Grade II is at Pay Level 10 with minimum basic pay of Rs. 70,900 a month, and Grade I at Level 12 with Rs. 1,01,500 a month. Total emoluments including HRA are Rs. 1,41,483 and Rs. 1,97,481 respectively.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IIT Indore faculty recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the "Click here to apply ONLINE" link on the IIT Indore careers page. Hard copies and email applications are not accepted, and certificates must be uploaded in PDF.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Assistant Professor Grade II post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the notice says the position of Assistant Professor Grade II will be on contract basis. It prints no such term for Grade I.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one position?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application must be submitted for each position, and an application is considered only for the position applied for.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel costs for the interview be reimbursed?
faq.answer: Applicants called for interview get economy-class air fare or II AC rail fare from the nearest airport/railway station of their present residence in India, with tickets booked through IRCTC or authorised agents. Applicants interviewed from abroad get no reimbursement.

faq.question: Q10. Who must produce a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Applicants employed in Government, Semi-Government, Autonomous Bodies, Institutions or PSUs must apply through proper channel. They must produce a No Objection Certificate with a Vigilance Clearance Certificate from their employer at the time of interview.
